text.en: Clients in Pimlico frequently praise the groomers for transforming tangled coats, detangling heavy matting, and leaving dogs smelling delightfully fresh. Handlers note that trims for Pomeranians, Chows, and mixed breeds look neat and evenly finished. While one customer noted longer waits and uneven clipping, overall styling outcomes remain solid.

Pet owners consistently describe the parlour as a friendly, family-run business where staff greet clients with warmth and genuine enthusiasm. Reviewers appreciate groomers who listen carefully to styling preferences and offer helpful advice. Although one client was dissatisfied following a staff departure, the team is widely commended for kindness.

Reviewers mention that groomers show patience and gentle care when working with timid dogs and large cats. Pet owners note that nervous animals remain calm throughout washing and brushing sessions without unnecessary stress. Clients value picking up relaxed companions that show genuine trust in the salon's handlers across repeated visits.

q.en: Does Tip Toe Grooming cater to cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, client reviews mention regular grooming appointments for long-haired cats, including Maine Coons, handled with gentle care.

q.en: Can the salon accommodate difficult or anxious pets?

a.en: Yes, owners of nervous dogs and challenging coats note that staff are patient, attentive, and flexible with handling.

q.en: Is Tip Toe Grooming a family-run business?

a.en: Yes, pet owners describe the shop as a welcoming, family-operated neighbourhood salon in Pimlico.
